module_summary: Lemmings Moore FSM: a six-state register (walk/fall/dig per direction) updated by prioritized ground, dig and bump inputs, with outputs decoded from state.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Six-state Moore controller encoding walking, falling and digging, each remembering direction.

anchors.name: ground
anchors.why: Highest-priority condition: absence forces falling, return resumes walking.

anchors.name: dig
anchors.why: Starts digging from a walking state when ground present.

anchors.name: bump_left
anchors.why: Reverses walk-left to walk-right; lowest priority.

anchors.name: bump_right
anchors.why: Reverses walk-right to walk-left; lowest priority.

anchors.name: aaah
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from either falling state.

anchors.name: digging
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from either digging state.

groups.name: lemming_fsm
groups.description: Prioritized next-state logic (fall > dig > bump) and state register.

groups.name: output_decode
groups.description: Decodes state into walk_left, walk_right, aaah and digging outputs.
